change: PERFORMANCE (3 fixes for continued slowness, especially older devices like the Lenovo): (1) refreshGroundPage's team performance calc used 2 separate full inspections scans (Team A, Team B) -- merged into 1 pass. (2) The Leaderboard did 4 separate full inspections scans (one per department: mech/elec/tyre/weld) -- merged into 1 pass. (3) BIGGEST: every device's live Firebase listener refreshes whichever page is currently open on THAT device on EVERY remote change from ANY device in the yard -- a punch anywhere, a save anywhere. During busy periods this meant back-to-back full page refreshes. Now debounced to 250ms so a burst of near-simultaneous updates collapses into a single refresh.
